heroBody: Expert computer repairs for Brisbane. We've fixed computers here since 2008.

sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.body: Reboot Computer Repairs has fixed computers in Brisbane since 2008. We're a small team of certified technicians, and between us we've seen most of what a PC or laptop can throw at you. We don't make excuses. We don't keep you waiting.

sections.heading: What We Fix
sections.body: Most computer problems are predictable. Virus infections. Hard drive failures. Battery wear. Overheating. We diagnose fast, explain what's wrong in plain English, and quote a fair price. If you approve, we fix it. If you don't, you leave with no obligation. Here's what we handle most often, see the full list on our services page.
bullets: Data recovery from failed and dead drives
Hardware repair for screens, batteries and ports
New computer setup and data migration

sections.heading: Why We're Different
bullets: No call out fees. You only pay for what we fix.
Open 7 AM to 10 PM every day, holidays included.
Most repairs done within the hour.
No fix, no fee. If we can't fix it, you don't pay.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Workshop repairs are $150 an hour. On site, it's $150 for the first hour, then $37.50 every 15 minutes. Remote service is $37.50 per 15 minutes. No hidden charges on any of it.

sections.heading: Where We Work
sections.body: We cover the Greater Brisbane area, including Logan, Ipswich, Moreton Bay and Redland Bay. We don't have technicians on the Sunshine Coast at the moment.

sections.heading: As Seen On Channel 9
sections.body: Channel 9 interviewed us about slow internet speeds around Brisbane.

ctaHeading: Ready to Get Your Computer Fixed?
ctaBody: Tell us what's going wrong and we'll come back with a price to fix it.
